store.tagline: A lone ronin cuts through the oni of a cursed land.
store.description:
Ink of the Oni is an isometric sumi-e action roguelike. Play a lone ronin cutting through waves of oni across four cursed regions of feudal Japan: a whispering bamboo grove, a burning village, a frozen temple and the Gate of Hell.

Chain katana combos, draw iai slashes, dash through attacks and level up as you fight. Choose abilities and upgrades from ink-brush scroll cards, collect katanas, charms and masks, and face four multi-phase bosses.

When you fall, the Spirit Ink you earned carries over to the Dojo, where you can unlock permanent upgrades, new starting katanas and extra abilities for your next run.

Plays on phone and desktop. Touch controls on phones; WASD, mouse and Q E R F abilities on desktop.
